facts.text: If your refund check was lost or stolen, you can request a refund trace.
The automated refund hotline is 800-829-1954; have your tax return on hand when you call.
Before starting a trace, confirm the full processing time has passed (within 4 weeks of issuance).
Joint filers contact 800-829-1040 or complete and send Form 3911.
You can also check your refund with the IRS mobile app.

refund-help.sourceNote: Refunds page lost-or-stolen and refund-trace sections.

facts.text: An e-filed return typically arrives 3 weeks after the date you e-filed.
A mailed return takes 6 or more weeks from the date the IRS received it.
Paper-return refund status is available 4 weeks after you file.
A refund can be delayed when the return needs corrections or further review.
Refunds claiming the Earned Income Credit are held until mid-February.

refund-timing.sourceNote: Refunds page availability and when-to-expect sections.

facts.text: Check your refund status with the Where's My Refund tracker.
You need the exact refund amount from your tax return.
You need your Social Security number or ITIN.
You need your filing status and the tax year.
Refund status is available 24 hours after you e-file a current-year return.
